crisis_windows.title_zh: 2015-08 人民币汇改与全球流动性闪崩
crisis_windows.narrative_en: 4/6 Crisis Lights + AD top-divergence armed two 90-DTE Collars ahead of the peak ($110.64 on 6/01 and $112.73 on 7/23). On 2015-08-24 when VIX/VIX3M spiked to 1.194, both tranches monetized at $94.23 Open for +$13,633 (+144.6 QQQ shares), cutting QQQ's -13.94% drawdown nearly in half.
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 暴跌前 4–5 盏危机灯叠加 AD 背离提前在 $110.64（6/01）与 $112.73（7/23）挂满双槽保护；8/24 闪崩开盘 VIX/VIX3M 飙至 1.194 触发止盈，在 $94.23 铁底一次性落袋 +$13,633 并抄底 +144.6 股 QQQ！

crisis_windows.narrative_en: 4/6 Crisis Lights fired 47 trading days before the top (Slot 1 Naked Put 6/25, Slot 2 Collar 7/26, refreshed Collar 10/05 @$182.36). First wave monetized on 10/11 (VIX/3M 1.109, +$5,545 / +32.4 sh), and U4's 6/6 Slow-Bear Shield shifted 50% to T-Bills on 10/25 & 11/12, cutting -22.69% MDD to -17.78% (+4.92% excess).
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 四灯在见顶前 47 个交易日提前亮起，10/05 在 $182.36 高位补齐 Collar，10/11 首波倒挂 1.109 止盈 +$5,545（+32.4股）；随后 6/6 灯全亮破年线，U4 慢熊盾于 10/25 与 11/12 减半仓避险，将 QQQ -22.69% 回撤压至 -17.78%（超额 +4.92%）！

crisis_windows.narrative_en: Honest out-of-sample disclosure: because COVID-19 was an exogenous biological shock while pre-peak macro lights were 2/6 and AD Line hit new highs, AD/4-Light switches held 0 pre-peak puts (zero Call cap drag in 2019's +39% melt-up), while U4's 5/6 Slow-Bear + VIX>=34 rapid reload rules preserved 100% of the April V-bottom rebound (+0.38% excess).
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 零前视客观披露：2020年2月见顶前宏观基本面仅亮 2/6 灯且全美 AD 创历史新高，纯内生宽度/宏观开关未提前挂 Put（也因此零损耗吃满 2019 年 +39% 主升浪）；3月破年线升至 5 灯后，U4 凭借 VIX>=34 / 1.10 极值秒回补机制丝毫未踏空 3/23 V 型反转（区间超额 +0.38%）。

crisis_windows.title_zh: 2022 全年激进加息阴跌慢熊 (-35.1% · 无恐慌倒挂)
crisis_windows.narrative_en: In 2022's frog-boiling grind, VIX/VIX3M peaked at just 1.022 (<1.10), starving pure option strategies of panic Vega spikes. This is why U4's Slow-Bear Shield exists: 5-6/6 Crisis Lights + QQQ < 200DMA shifted 50% into 3M T-Bills on 2022-01-31 @$353.20 across 5 defensive waves, slashing max drawdown from -35.12% to -30.50% (+4.56% excess return)!
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 2022 温水煮青蛙阴跌中 VIX/VIX3M 全年最高仅 1.022（未达 1.10），纯期权难以触发恐慌爆波收割。U4 慢熊盾精准补位：2022-01-31 在 $353.20 因五灯破年线果断减半仓转美债，全年五轮防御将最大回撤从 -35.12% 大砍至 -30.50%（超额 +4.56%）！

When the Nikkei/Yen carry shock pushed VIX/VIX3M to 1.144 on 2024-08-05, both slots monetized at $437.23 Open on 8/06 for +$30,832 in U4 / +$31,945 in U1 (+70.5 to +73.1 QQQ shares), cutting DD to -8.05%!

On 2025-04-07 Open @$408.66 (VIX/3M 1.234), that single tranche harvested +$67,287 in U4 / +$69,572 in U1 (+164.6 to +170.2 shares at the exact bottom!), beating QQQ by +6.41%!
